name: agile-infographics-library
description: Agile Infographics Library: independent, editable React infographic components (one package per component) plus a development gallery.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @agile-infographics/core && npm run build -w @agile-infographics/tom-wheel && npm run build -w @agile-infographics/methodology-flow
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:packages && npm run build:gallery
scripts.test: npm run build:gallery && npm run test:browser
